---
title: "Practical resources"
---

The original brief specifies 53 checklists and templates. They remain tracked in the requirements register, but most are not yet substantive enough to publish as finished resources. They are no longer presented here as if they were ready.

The first usable release is a set of checklists organised around **consequential pause points**: moments when a short check can still prevent avoidable harm, rework or an indefensible decision.

## Phase checkpoints

- [Starting candidature](checklists/starting-candidature.qmd)
- [First 90-day review](checklists/first-90-day-review.qmd)
- [Before committing to each study](checklists/before-study-commitment.qmd)
- [Before ethics or governance submission](checklists/before-ethics-submission.qmd)
- [Before data collection](checklists/before-data-collection.qmd)
- [Before analysis](checklists/before-analysis.qmd)
- [Before writing up a study](checklists/before-study-write-up.qmd)
- [Before manuscript submission](checklists/before-manuscript-submission.qmd)
- [Before thesis submission](checklists/before-thesis-submission.qmd)
- [Before project closure and handover](checklists/project-closure-handover.qmd)

Read [how these checklists work](checklists/index.qmd) before using them.

## Still to be completed

The remaining resource families include supervision records, topic and question due diligence, literature searching and synthesis, methods and piloting, data management and reproducibility, Git and responsible AI use, feedback and authorship, journal and reviewer work, escalation, examination, and handover.

The public repository keeps the row-by-row status in [`planning/requirements-checklist.csv`](https://github.com/hareshsuppiah/handbook-for-the-recently-enrolled/blob/main/planning/requirements-checklist.csv) and the current corrective audit in [`planning/incomplete-work-audit-2026-08-28.md`](https://github.com/hareshsuppiah/handbook-for-the-recently-enrolled/blob/main/planning/incomplete-work-audit-2026-08-28.md).
